lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits.

Chain 40 is on main since 00:38 UTC (5:38 PM MT Friday): fall's darker air and the one smear for each flying petal and leaf. Stated by the helper that ran it, every floor of the order is met: only fall's two guard pictures moved, the four shakes measure 0.9694, 0.889, 0.9572 and 0.961, the whole test run 1054 passed and 8 skipped. What I see beside the approved pictures: at rest the air behind fall's tree is now a dark green dusk, nearer the approved; at the landing the storm is still paler and milkier than the approved. Fall stays below the bar. The live page is still round two (the twelfth publish); chain 40 is not published yet.

The change of season at 4K at the masters' tier on round two's tree, film frames 668 to 671: winter's mound of snow leaves whole, so the condition set for the rework is met. One faint straight line in winter's frost right of the foot at frame 668 stays open until its builder proves the cause (item 275).

Summer. The see through swirl at the landing is accepted as it stands and is in chain 41, ordered at 00:41 UTC (5:41 PM MT): cottage, lamp post and trunk read through a pale veil where round two hid them. It is still below the approved, whose storm is finer. Two things found in it are being mended by its builder: at 4K the fireflies' streaks are flat yellow green bars with square ends (item 276), and at the close camera of the stills the seeds' down gathers into lumps of touching dots at the final tier (item 277; whether the film's own camera can show it is being reckoned). Summer's miniature at the film's framing needs no mend by my look at round one beside round two (decision 240); the pond's flat pale plates at rest stay below the bar.

The petals' smear at 4K. Film frame 2121: every arriving leaf is one smear, accepted. Film frames 1388 and 1389: no rows of copies any more, but at full size I see a crossed weave inside the darker smears (item 278). Its builder found the cause in the code: every sample of a frame lays the same grain tile over the same pixels. The mend is ordered; by its own estimate the first 4K picture comes about 01:45 UTC (6:45 PM MT).

Rough draft 7 of the film is being drawn by four helpers on chain 41's tree: three of twelve chunks are in. Preview 07 comes with a later status when the rest arrive. It will not hold spring's glass mend or the patch for the stall at low quality.

The final render on his own computer. Stated at 00:27 UTC (5:27 PM MT) by the builder of the one file for Claude Code: the tools are written and not pushed, they are proven only on its own Linux machine in software, and nothing is proven on Windows or macOS yet. Its own estimate, a guess: the first Windows run about 7:00 PM MT, its last report about 2:00 AM MT Saturday. No final render is started in the cloud.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The late pieces (chain 41 with summer's swirl, chain 42 with spring's glass and, if it comes whole, the patch for the stall at low quality): the thirteenth publish at the same address. Preview 07: the whole film with sound at 960x540. The render instructions: one file in the repo. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order (card loop, judged stills, record round, preview films, proof of the local render, cue sheet, README, last publish, gauntlet) and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last, a fresh reviewer's score against the showcase standard.

Open, below the bar: fall's storm paler than approved; spring's glass bare after a shake (being mended, report about 6:17 PM MT); spring's fence and trails; items 275 to 278 above; the stall at low quality (whole report about 5:52 PM MT); winter's four small items; fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face (item 272); a faint saw tooth in the grass left of summer's pond (item 270); the petals' fringe at film frame 680; a nudge at film frames 2113 to 2117; the poster tool that stops on one failed request (item 273).
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 00:42 UTC: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 06.
